from: September book, night 3 (Children Are a Gift)
p1: Long ago in Israel, parents passed their land down to their children. That land was a precious gift kept in the family.
A song in the Bible says children are a gift like that. It sings, “Children are a heritage of the Lord.” Each child is a precious gift from Him.
Heavenly Father gave you to your family. You are their precious gift, and you are His child too.
p2: The song also says the Lord gives sleep to the ones He dearly loves. Jesus loved children too. He took them up in His arms and blessed them.
You are a precious gift, and you are dearly loved. Snuggle down now, and let sweet sleep come.
old: Heavenly Father loves families very much. One of the Psalms is a happy song all about home and children.
“Unless Heavenly Father helps build the house, the builders work for nothing,” the song says. That means Heavenly Father is the one who helps our family and home grow strong and happy.
Then the song says something sweet: “Children are a gift from Heavenly Father!” Every child — including YOU — is a special present He gives to a family.
The song paints a happy picture: a mom and dad and their little ones gathered close, like young plants growing round a table full of love.
Your family is a gift, and you are a gift too! Heavenly Father helps your home be a place of love, where you are treasured every single day.
